signing.summary: Signing stops anyone without the key from sending commands to this vehicle over the radio.
signing.randomHint: This computer makes a random key and keeps it. Another ground station cannot be given it.
signing.loss: If this computer loses the key, no ground station can command the vehicle over the radio until its signing is reset over USB.
signing.confirmRandom: A random key is made, kept on this computer and sent to the vehicle.
signing.confirmPassphrase: The key made from the passphrase is kept on this computer and sent to the vehicle.
signing.confirmOffWhat: Signing is turned off on the vehicle and its key is removed from this computer. Any ground station can then command it.

state.noAnswer: The vehicle does not sign with the key this computer holds
state.unknownKey: The vehicle signs with a key this computer does not have

note.off: Any ground station can command this vehicle.
note.signed: This computer and the vehicle share a key. Other ground stations need it too.
note.noAnswer: The key may be wrong, or the vehicle's signing was reset. The link is not signed, and over a radio the vehicle ignores commands. Set a new key over USB, or turn signing off.
note.unknownKey: Another ground station set it. Over a radio the vehicle ignores this computer's commands. Connect over USB to set a new key or turn signing off.

phraseHint.ok: Other ground stations make the same key from the same passphrase.
phraseHint.long: A passphrase is at most 256 characters.

blocked.offline: Connect a vehicle to set up signing.
blocked.unknown: The vehicle's state is not known. Signing is changed only on a vehicle known to be disarmed.
blocked.armed: The vehicle is armed. Signing is changed only on the ground, disarmed.
blocked.busy: A signing change is under way.

error.ARMED: The vehicle is armed. Disarm it, then try again.
error.STATE_UNKNOWN: The vehicle's state is not known. Wait for its heartbeat, then try again.
error.BUSY: Something else is under way: parameters, a plan, logs, a calibration, a motor test or a reboot. Try again when it is done.
error.NO_VEHICLE_ID: The vehicle is not identified yet. Try again in a moment.
error.NOT_SAVED: The key could not be saved on this computer, so nothing was sent to the vehicle. Check the app's data folder.
error.NOT_CONFIRMED: The vehicle did not confirm. Check that its firmware supports signing, then try again. Over a radio, a vehicle that signs takes this only with its own key: use USB.
error.ABORTED: The link was lost before the vehicle confirmed. The key is kept, in case the vehicle took it.
error.other: Signing could not be changed. Try again.
